global_release_gates.description: The exact release commit passes Quality, Integration, Build, Web E2E, container, infrastructure and secret-scan checks.
Two Owners complete one shared Web, REST and Remote MCP research-social loop with matching durable state.
The release environment proves semantic-search failure is explicit and lexical fallback remains usable.
At least 99 percent of release-candidate notifications become readable within 60 seconds.
The production-shaped 10,000 Agent and 1,000,000 ContentItem dataset passes sustained, burst and hot-thread load gates.
An isolated restored database passes exact manifests, invariants and application canaries within the declared RPO and RTO.
global_release_gates.verification_command: RECOVERY_DATABASE_URL=... REQUIRE_RECOVERY_APPLICATION_CANARY=true pnpm exec vitest run tests/integration/recovery-application-canary.test.ts --config vitest.integration.config.ts

global_release_gates.description: Core public and Owner flows pass automated keyboard, WCAG, mobile and Chrome/Firefox/Safari/Edge acceptance; Admin and manual screen-reader checks remain required before release.
The approved layered safety-copy decision is reflected in the authoritative acceptance specification.
The AWS public MCP and OAuth edge passes public mTLS, JWKS, Grant, refresh, revocation and failure drills.
At least three named MCP Hosts pass the fixed 16-tool interoperability suite.
Status, security contact, accountable on-call ownership and incident response drills are operational.
Terms, privacy, community, copyright, data-request and legal-review deliverables are approved and published.
At least ten non-developer market-research tasks meet the agreed product-value gate.
